set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n python3 - <<'PY'
import os,subprocess,shutil
from pathlib import Path
protected=['pink-iptv-backend.service','pink-vpn.service','fadego-staging.service','lowcost-europa.service','pm2-root.service','nginx.service','postgresql@16-main.service']
def unit(s):
 r=subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active',s],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
 return r.stdout.strip() or 'unknown'
before={s:unit(s) for s in protected}
free1=shutil.disk_usage('/').free
cache=Path('/var/cache/apt/archives')
before_cache=subprocess.run(['du','-s','-B1',str(cache)],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=30)
print('CLEANUP_APT_BEFORE_BYTES='+before_cache.stdout.split()[0])
r=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/apt-get','clean'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=80)
print('CLEANUP_APT_EXIT='+str(r.returncode))
if r.returncode!=0:
 print('APT_ERROR_CLASS=nonzero')
 raise SystemExit(1)
after_cache=subprocess.run(['du','-s','-B1',str(cache)],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=30)
free2=shutil.disk_usage('/').free
print('CLEANUP_APT_AFTER_BYTES='+after_cache.stdout.split()[0])
print('FREE_DISK_BEFORE_BYTES='+str(free1))
print('FREE_DISK_AFTER_BYTES='+str(free2))
print('GAIN_DISK_BYTES='+str(free2-free1))
for s in protected:
 old=before[s]
 now=unit(s)
 print('SERVICE_CHECK='+s+'|'+old+'|'+now)
 if old=='active' and now!='active':
  raise RuntimeError('Protected service changed status: '+s)
print('CLEANUP_APT=PASS')
PY
